verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change is correct and complete within the diff's scope. Each newly widened per-object boundary preserves the existing fail-closed decision: unreadable snapshots and revalidation evidence exclude mutations or retain leases, while independent objects and repositories continue. Arbitrary exception details are consistently routed through the bounded, single-line credential-shape mask. Defuse collection and mutation-boundary read failures are now carried into the shared phase outcome, so an all-failed phase exits non-zero without preventing downstream lease reclamation; successful revalidation skips remain distinct from failures. The RedraftUnavailable precedence remains intact. The added tests exercise non-GroomError failures at each production call site, both partial-success and all-failed status semantics, masking wiring, lease-retention direction, and the run_sweep collection seam with fixed expectations and non-vacuous controls.
